semiconductor_relevance: High — Chipex Technologies is directly involved in the VLSI design and development process, providing custom IC and SoC design services.
summary: Chipex Technologies Private Limited is a VLSI startup offering custom integrated circuit and system-on-chip design services. They provide comprehensive turnkey solutions, including architecture, design, verification, and silicon testing, leveraging both in-house and third-party IP to deliver high-quality silicon solutions.
